verdict.rationale: Gumloop puts only adjacent pieces under source control. Organization Skills can be kept in sync with a GitHub repository, and Hosted MCP server code deploys automatically on every push to main. Separately, the API lets you create and update agents from code, so you could version agent definitions externally as a workaround. Missing for 10: native versioning of agents/workflows themselves, separate dev/staging/production environments, a documented promotion workflow from dev to prod, rollback, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
